verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Fellow's REST API, webhooks, Fellow Markdown note editing, and MCP server governance. None of it documents a user-defined automation feature with version history, review or approval of changes, or rollback to a prior version. Round-tripping note markdown and revoking MCP connections are adjacent features, not automation versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
